aan-tics.title: AAN: Treatment of tics in Tourette syndrome and chronic tic disorders
aan-tics.evidenceType: Clinical practice guideline, 2019; watchful waiting and CBIT decisions depend on impairment
aan-tics.access: Search index verified 2026-10-10; full text retrieval blocked by CAPTCHA

aasm-insomnia.title: AASM: Behavioral and psychological treatments for chronic insomnia in adults
aasm-insomnia.evidenceType: Graded clinical practice guideline, 2021; multicomponent CBT-I strongly recommended

asha-aphasia.title: ASHA Practice Portal: Aphasia
asha-aphasia.evidenceType: Professional practice synthesis for acquired aphasia in adults; SLP assessment and rehabilitation

asha-literacy.title: ASHA Practice Portal: Written language disorders
asha-literacy.evidenceType: Professional practice synthesis; not proof that any particular school accommodation improves literacy

cci-bdd.title: CCI: Body dysmorphia
cci-bdd.evidenceType: Public CBT self-help education; not a graded guideline or reproduced workbook

cci-health.title: CCI: Health anxiety
cci-health.evidenceType: Public CBT self-help education; medical symptoms still require appropriate assessment

comb-trial.title: Carlson et al.: ComB treatment of trichotillomania randomized trial
comb-trial.evidenceType: Primary randomized trial, 2021; 36 adults with hair pulling. Self-reported symptoms improved versus minimal-attention control; interviewer-rated symptoms/diagnostic status did not show significant immediate differences. Not generalized to all BFRBs
comb-trial.access: PubMed abstract retrieved 2026-10-10; full trial not reviewed

nctsn-family.title: NCTSN: Physical abuse interventions
nctsn-family.evidenceType: Specialist network intervention directory; model age/indication/training vary

nctsn-grief.title: NCTSN: Childhood traumatic grief
nctsn-grief.evidenceType: Specialist network education; child traumatic grief, not all grief or adult diagnostic criteria

nice-adhd.title: NICE NG87: ADHD diagnosis and management
nice-adhd.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2018; assessment requires developmental and cross-setting evidence

nice-autism.title: NICE CG142: Autism in adults
nice-autism.evidenceType: Published adult guideline, 2012; accommodations are individualized

nice-depression.title: NICE NG222: Depression in adults
nice-depression.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2022; treatment choice depends on severity, preference and history
nice-depression.access: Official search index verified 2026-10-10; full recommendations retrieval limited

nice-eating.title: NICE NG69: Eating disorders recognition and treatment
nice-eating.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2017; does not establish a complete ARFID, pica or rumination pathway
nice-eating.access: Official NICE recommendations sections 1.2, 1.10 and 1.11 checked 2026-10-10; not a full systematic evidence review

nice-id.title: NICE NG11: Challenging behaviour and learning disabilities
nice-id.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2015. UK learning disability here means intellectual disability

nice-ocd.title: NICE CG31: OCD and body dysmorphic disorder
nice-ocd.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2005; update in development in 2026. Draft is not final guidance
nice-ocd.access: Official search index verified 2026-10-10; full recommendations retrieval limited

nice-pain.title: NICE NG193: Chronic pain
nice-pain.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2021; chronic primary and secondary pain need differentiated care

nice-panic.title: NICE CG113: Generalised anxiety and panic disorder in adults
nice-panic.evidenceType: Published clinical guideline, 2011; jurisdiction and update status matter
nice-panic.access: Official search index verified 2026-10-10; full recommendations retrieval limited

nice-ptsd.title: NICE NG116: Post-traumatic stress disorder
nice-ptsd.evidenceType: Published guideline, 2018; age, timing, safety and treatment training matter
nice-ptsd.access: Official search index verified 2026-10-10; full recommendations retrieval limited

nice-social.title: NICE CG159: Social anxiety disorder
nice-social.evidenceType: Published clinical guideline, 2013; adult and youth recommendations differ
nice-social.access: Official search index verified 2026-10-10; full recommendations retrieval limited

nimh-bipolar.title: NIMH: Bipolar disorder
nimh-bipolar.evidenceType: Federal clinical education; not a graded treatment guideline

nimh-psychosis.title: NIMH: Understanding psychosis
nimh-psychosis.evidenceType: Federal clinical education; coordinated specialty care orientation

pbis-fba.title: Center on PBIS: Tier 3 comprehensive functional behavior assessment guide
pbis-fba.evidenceType: Implementation guidance, 2022; observations generate hypotheses, not causal proof
pbis-fba.access: Official page verified during earlier CPL audit

tlc-bfrb.title: TLC Foundation: Evidence-based therapeutic treatment for BFRBs
tlc-bfrb.evidenceType: Specialist foundation education; HRT/ComB orientation, not graded guidance for all BFRBs

va-dissociation.title: VA National Center for PTSD: Dissociative subtype of PTSD
va-dissociation.evidenceType: Professional clinical synthesis; PTSD subtype is not dissociative identity disorder

topicCrosswalk.title: Bipolar: episodes, baseline and support
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original timeline and examples are teaching aids, not a bipolar screening instrument. The source supports broad education, not a complete diagnostic or medication protocol. Qualified review of episode and escalation language remains pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Psychosis: voices, distress and collaborative coping
topicCrosswalk.limits: This is an original collaborative discussion aid, not CBT for psychosis training, a diagnostic algorithm or a command-hallucination risk scale. Care decisions require qualified assessment.

topicCrosswalk.title: Sleep loss: exhaustion or rising activation?
topicCrosswalk.limits: The pattern map is not validated triage. It offers no diagnostic cutoffs or sleep-restriction prescription. AASM guidance concerns chronic insomnia treatment, not acute mania management.

topicCrosswalk.title: Panic: body sensations and the alarm loop
topicCrosswalk.limits: The loop is an original psychoeducational aid, not a diagnostic or medical triage instrument. Guideline principles require trained implementation; no proprietary CBT protocol or measure is reproduced.

topicCrosswalk.title: Social anxiety: attention, predictions and safety strategies
topicCrosswalk.limits: This original attention map is not a complete social-anxiety protocol. NICE adult/youth guidance differs; this set is adult-oriented. Accommodation decisions and anxiety treatment require individualized review.

topicCrosswalk.title: OCD: mental rituals, reassurance and uncertainty
topicCrosswalk.limits: NICE CG31 remains published guidance; a 2026 update is in development. This aid is not an ERP protocol, OCD scale or classification of religious practice. Clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Depression: activity, reward and workable steps
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original planning prompts are not a behavioral-activation manual or validated depression measure. Treatment selection depends on severity, preference, history and qualified assessment.

topicCrosswalk.title: Trauma cues: present orientation and chosen support
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original orientation map is not a trauma-treatment protocol. Dissociation does not automatically exclude trauma-focused treatment; selection is individualized. Clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Dissociation: orientation, time gaps and daily function
topicCrosswalk.limits: VA source covers the PTSD dissociative subtype, not a comprehensive guide to DID or all dissociative conditions. This set intentionally avoids diagnostic thresholds, memory-recovery practices and trauma-treatment exclusion rules.

topicCrosswalk.title: Child grief: remembrance, routines and traumatic reminders
topicCrosswalk.limits: NCTSN supports child traumatic-grief education. This original remembrance aid is not a grief-treatment protocol or diagnostic measure. Age, culture, family context and qualified review remain essential.

topicCrosswalk.title: Restrictive eating: medical coordination and supported participation
topicCrosswalk.limits: Coordination aid only. NG69 does not provide a complete ARFID/pica/rumination pathway. No validated eating-disorder items, nutritional prescriptions or diagnostic thresholds are reproduced.

topicCrosswalk.title: Binge eating: patterns, shame and treatment engagement
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original pattern aid is not a binge-eating measure or treatment manual. Specialist treatment, medical assessment and individualized nutrition planning remain outside its scope.

topicCrosswalk.title: Adult autism: load, access and recovery
topicCrosswalk.limits: Adult-oriented access aid, not an autism assessment or validated burnout scale. Supports are individualized; evidence for specific sensory strategies varies. Clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Adult ADHD: task starts and external scaffolds
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original initiation aid is not an ADHD screening test or executive-function measure. Scaffold effectiveness is individualized and does not prove diagnosis. No medication advice provided.

topicCrosswalk.title: Acquired aphasia: supported communication and participation
topicCrosswalk.limits: ASHA source concerns acquired adult aphasia. This unvalidated access aid does not establish capacity, rehabilitation effectiveness or validity of modified standardized scores. Qualified clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Learning differences: instruction and access are separate tracks
topicCrosswalk.limits: ASHA provides written-language practice orientation, not universal school eligibility rules. Original two-track aid is not a diagnostic test or legally sufficient plan. No proprietary assessment items reproduced.

topicCrosswalk.title: Intellectual disability: supported choice and functional communication
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original supported-choice aid is not a capacity test or intellectual-disability assessment. UK terminology and jurisdiction limits are explicit. Qualified clinical and rights review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Tics: context, impact and CBIT referral
topicCrosswalk.limits: AAN 2019 guideline supports impact-based treatment decisions including watchful waiting and CBIT. Full text retrieval was CAPTCHA-limited; original aid requires qualified review and does not reproduce a CBIT protocol.

topicCrosswalk.title: Body-focused repetitive behaviors: awareness and tailored support
topicCrosswalk.limits: TLC education plus a trichotillomania trial informs orientation, not graded guidance for all BFRBs. Original map is not HRT/ComB training or a validated symptom measure. Clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Body dysmorphic concerns: checking and participation
topicCrosswalk.limits: NICE OCD/BDD update is in development; published CG31 remains the cited guideline. CCI is public CBT education. Original aid is not a BDD measure, mirror-exposure protocol or cosmetic decision support.

topicCrosswalk.title: Health anxiety: checking and a clear medical plan
topicCrosswalk.limits: CCI is public CBT education. This original aid is not a medical triage algorithm, reassurance-withholding protocol or health-anxiety measure. Qualified clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Chronic pain: pacing, function and access
topicCrosswalk.limits: NICE NG193 distinguishes primary/secondary pain. Original pacing map is not a rehabilitation protocol, condition-specific exercise prescription or validated pain outcome measure.

topicCrosswalk.title: Insomnia: assessment questions and CBT-I readiness
topicCrosswalk.limits: AASM 2021 guideline addresses behavioral/psychological treatment. This aid does not cover medication selection or replace current combination-treatment guidance. Original unvalidated referral/planning tool; clinical review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Child aggression: safety, function and caregiver coaching
topicCrosswalk.limits: Original observation/coaching aid, not a comprehensive FBA or a manual for any caregiver treatment. No functional causation or diagnosis is inferred from one event. Qualified review pending.

topicCrosswalk.title: Sibling conflict: power, safety and repair
topicCrosswalk.limits: NCTSN family-harm education informs protective orientation; PBIS supports observation/hypothesis limits. Original sibling aid is not a validated abuse screen, legal determination or family-mediation protocol.
